scope: Synthetic continuous multimodal mechanism experiment; no foundation-model or native-Hepta qualification claim

primary.comparator: Validation-selected direct supervised decoder, ordinary guidance, or trained free joint controller within1.10 times NDU measured CPU inference budget; at least one same-actuator free controller must be eligible
primary.selection: minimum validation CVaR90 among cost-eligible candidates; same data, codec, initial foundation, context and public target predictor
primary.diversity_definition: Mean per-condition entropy in bits of four lawful-and-crossmodally-consistent generated styles; invalid styles contribute zero mass. Ratio to selected baseline, with both near-zero scored as failure.

external_evaluation: Fixed true facts read back from actual decoded text/audio/image/video; p never changes the evaluator
stochasticity: Flow initial latent noise supplies diversity; no claim that it is semantic uncertainty or a reverse diffusion SDE
valuation: Costly controlled p changes bounded per-fact valuation and correction gains; operational NDU special case, with fixed external evaluation
control: Receding-horizon differentiable affine discrete Riccati on Euler linearization and Gauss-Newton cost; exact only for each local quadratic subproblem
oracle: Separate continuous risk-neutral joint LQ reference with zero preference diffusion and independent BVP/QP/finite-difference checks
cost_accounting: End-to-end CPU wall and process time including encoder, flow, controller/linearization/solves and all decoders; record training time separately; no incomplete MAC count called total FLOPs
test_rules: Publish protocol and freeze implementation hashes before heldout execution
Development runs use separate seed and cannot satisfy scientific gates
Freeze all baseline choices before generating heldout worlds
Retain every heldout attempt and negative result; no outcome-dependent retuning
Bootstrap groups all four draws within each world and resamples training seeds
If no same-actuator comparator fits measured cost, mark fairness blocker instead of replacing it with fixed-p
A successful process exit certifies execution, not scientific superiority
Dedicated cloud requires externally verified runner assignment and matching source receipt

free_controller_compute_match.rule: Continue on same training pool until CPU wall training time reaches joint NDU training time, or cap; record actual steps and time.

continuation_encoder: Frozen identical encoder after foundation; decoder also frozen. NDU training updates vector-field parameters through the solver; does not claim joint NDU codec training.
timing: Fixed128-world batches,4draws perworld,8-world warmup excluded and recorded; median3validation repeats,1heldout repeat; bothwall andprocessCPU times
explicitness: Textminimumtopprob>=0.20; image/video fittedsingleGaussian residual<0.50,width0.045-0.120; audioamp>0.1,fitresidual<0.50; nonfiniteoutputs loss1 invalid
decoder_schedule: Fresh shared time-conditioned frame decoder with squared nonnegative image/video link and raw physical moment training loss; cosine learning rate 0.001 to 0.0001; fixed 10000 updates
initial_condition: All trajectories start at z_facts(0) = encoder_estimate + 0.5 * standard_normal_noise; z_style(0) = standard_normal_noise; p(0) = 0. Flow Matching uses the same conditional initial distribution.
